traps.why: Page 10 ends with a two-row EMR results index (07May22 | Normal | Pask , Leane | X-Ray | X-Ray, Chest and 28Apr22 | Normal | Chao , Claire | X-Ray | X-Ray, Sinuses/Chest). These are pointers to reports held elsewhere, not reports. The only document on page 10 is the GAD-7.
The 28Apr22 study is abnormal. The index row's status word 'Normal' is a workflow flag and must never be reported as a radiologist's impression.

On pages 10 and 12 these people are the provider, deliver-to, family physician, or addressee. The authors are Adarsh Patel (page 12) and Tom Waslen (page 11). Dr. Leane Pask IS a legitimate author, but only of the report form on pages 3-7.
Page 7 is Part 8 of the Physician's Initial Report Form, printed 'Page 5 of 5'. Splitting it off as its own administrative document discards the form's author and date.
Two different instruments: the Appendix A screening tool and the Alberta Health Services PCFS/Symptom Checklist. They must not merge into one entry.
Page 29 is a clinical photograph of the face. Describing it as a radiograph with a laterality marker is invented detail.
